mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs per month), a tightening labor market fuels wage inflation, pressuring equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 2-month increase in INDPRO, indicating strengthening industrial production, signals improved supply chain efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of INDPRO growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds $700 billion, indicating strong retail sales, consumer confidence is boosted, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances with RSAFS above $700 billion, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 2% and CPIAUCSL growth decelerates (< 2% YoY), a dovish monetary stance combined with subdued inflation pressures equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.06 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1.6 million and GDPC1 growth > 3% QoQ
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3.5-year rolling window.
